verdict.rationale: Wise documents business payments from a Wise account via API, batch transfers of up to 1000 payments, and describes itself as offering "domestic and cross-border payments tools," so domestic vendor payouts fall within its own documented capability. The pack never names outbound ACH or domestic wire as payout rails. The ACH reference (wise-docs-23) covers direct debit for funding batches from an external account, not paying vendors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of outbound ACH payments to US vendors, explicit domestic wire (e.g., Fedwire) support, a vendor/AP payment workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
